series_name: Historical Monthly Borrowing Rate for ERN Part 52

reconstructed_ffr.description: Reconstructed daily FFR from newspaper reports (Anbil et al. 2020)
reconstructed_ffr.daily_methodology: Average both newspapers' midpoints when both available; use single newspaper when only one reports (Anbil et al.)
reconstructed_ffr.monthly_methodology: Arithmetic mean of available daily observations (FBF framework decision)

fedfunds.description: Federal Funds Effective Rate (Board of Governors)
fedfunds.monthly_methodology: FRED monthly averages of daily figures
